title: Algebraizability of Vector Bundles over Real Algebraic Varieties
summary: Let $X$ be an affine smooth real algebraic variety (in the sense of Bochnak, Coste, and Roy) and let $V$ be a topological vector bundle over $X(\mathbb{R})$. We investigate the problem of deciding whether $V$ is topologically isomorphic to an algebraic vector bundle using motivic homotopy theory. We prove that if $\dim X\leq 3$, then the algebraicity of Stiefel-Whitney classes is a necessary and sufficient condition for $V$ to be algebraizable.
